evaluation_consumer_contract.differs_from_pa_stream_by_design: the PA book consumes one whole-tape selection made once and never reset; the Evaluation re-selects inside every 30-day cycle. The two phases never share a selector.

scaling.commission_timing_parity: reference/shared_source/pa.py charges the round-turn commission only in closing net P&L

acquisition.greedy_semantics: greedy in time, not in batch: buy at every event cash allows, at most one Evaluation per decision, never fill several open slots at one instant

external_capital.bridge_chain_semantics: the $35 owner seed purchases eval-1; only eval-1 renewals and eval-1 activation may receive bridge contributions

rejected_alternative.time_based_until_first_activation: rejected: it can externally fund Evaluations 2..N merely because their fees occur before the first activation

external_capital.required_reporting: owner capital, evaluation and activation fees, book-fill time, and pipeline-versus-cash binding must be measured; raw one-PA tape profit does not establish which constraint binds

lifecycle_timing.candidate_set: the six request-size policies stand unchanged

open_position_handling.mechanism: settle all trades due at or before the 23:59 Tallinn payout phase, then evaluate each PA independently
open_position_handling.deferred_pa_state: leave balance, payout count, cumulative payout totals, and payout-period daily-PnL history unchanged
open_position_handling.unaffected_pa_behavior: an active PA absent from every outstanding batch remains independently eligible
open_position_handling.same_timestamp_exit_rule: the exit settles before payout, so a copy settling exactly at 23:59 does not cause deferral and its realized PnL counts
open_position_handling.repeated_deferral_rule: repeat at every 23:59 close crossed by the open copy; do not synthesize a close or discard accrued payout-period history
open_position_handling.future_sit_out_sensitivity: deferred; any later sit-out arm must decide causally from prior-close or session-open state and may not retroactively suppress trades

terminal_sweep.role: right-censoring valuation, reported as un-withdrawn equity

accumulation_trigger_candidate.proposal: withdraw $1,000 for each $5,000 of account gain

measured_evidence_1_mnq_720d_window.window_scope: accepted-opportunity starts with a complete 720-day future interval
measured_evidence_1_mnq_720d_window.method: cumulative gross_pnl_usd_per_mnq minus commission over the accepted stream, before drawdown deaths and before the 26,600 payout gate

accumulation_trigger_candidate.interpretation_limit: this raw-window diagnostic does not establish a lifecycle policy ranking; exclusion follows the user-requested exact six-policy phase-1 scope
accumulation_trigger_candidate.reconsider_if: phase 2 introduces scaling above 1 MNQ, which would raise per-account gains enough for the trigger to bind

event_order.principle: settle what is outstanding, realize the cash that follows, spend it, then commit new exposure
event_order.code_binding: milky_cow.lifecycle._PHASE_RANK, asserted equal to this list by test

random_order_rejected.reason_determinism: this study's value rests on byte-reproducible results bound to input digests. A random event order means the accepted-stream digest no longer determines the result, and no run could be reproduced or audited.
random_order_rejected.reason_comparability: the parent fixes its order (same_event_order and boundary_event_order), so a randomized order cannot be differenced against it
random_order_rejected.reason_information: if order does not matter, randomizing buys nothing but variance; if it does matter, randomizing hides the effect inside that variance instead of exposing it

event_order.known_binding_edge: payout must precede renewal, activation and purchase. The parent makes payout cash available at the same atomic timestamp, so reversing this pair would stall the book for want of cash it actually holds. At least one permutation therefore does change results; 'no variant matters' is not safe in general.

sensitivity_plan.purpose: stress whether same-timestamp payout liquidity changes lifecycle spending without introducing random event order

owner_net_retained_cash.interpretation: owner wealth realized and still retained by the treasury after every lifecycle fee

cumulative_payout_harvest.interpretation: gross realized withdrawals before subtracting reinvested Evaluation, renewal, and activation fees

economic_objective.recommendation: use owner_net_retained_cash as the headline and cumulative_payout_harvest as a secondary metric; report unwithdrawn equity separately

rolling_cohort_rule.cadence: first accepted-opportunity session of each calendar month
rolling_cohort_rule.rationale: 55 complete monthly cohorts x 20 N values x 6 payout policies gives 6,600 central-arm runs and 19,800 runs across all three required path arms. Later tape starts are excluded from equal-horizon comparisons rather than silently right-censored.
rolling_cohort_rule.parent_comparability_note: the parent used rolling daily session starts; a daily-start robustness check on one selected arm keeps the comparison honest
rolling_cohort_rule.independence_caveat: cohorts overlap, so they are separate historical opportunities and NOT independent samples; no naive confidence interval is valid across them

horizon_and_right_censoring.primary_rationale: matches the parent horizon; the comparison is invalid at any other length
horizon_and_right_censoring.diagnostic_rationale: the long horizon is a book-fill and funding diagnostic on user-selected N values, not a second full grid. It must measure whether cash or Evaluation pipeline time binds rather than assume either.

horizon_crossing_trade_treatment.parent_parity: matches the parent event-loop treatment while preserving the exact 720-day cutoff without invented mark-to-market

right_censoring.withdrawn: cash actually received by the treasury under the policy's own rules
right_censoring.unwithdrawn: surviving PA account equity above the 25,000 nominal at horizon
right_censoring.running_evaluations_at_horizon: counted as sunk fees, never as an asset
right_censoring.why_separate: unwithdrawn equity was never rules-eligible to withdraw at the horizon instant, so summing it into the objective would credit policies with money the prop-firm rules would not have released

regime_definitions.role: reporting partition of cohort start dates; never reaches the simulator and cannot change a cohort result

calendar_windows.contract: half-open [from_date, to_date), ordered, contiguous, unbounded at both ends
calendar_windows.source: parent parity; a reporting convention, not a claim of a structural break

volatility_partition.basis: terciles of the per-calendar-month mean candle_range across the whole verified tape
volatility_partition.why_this_metric: candle_range is a tape input, not a policy outcome, so partitioning on it is not circular with the measured result

directional_regimes_not_defined.blocker: the frozen tape carries completed-trade records only: ticket, timestamps, MAE, MFE, PnL, candle_range. It has no price series, so direction cannot be derived without importing external MNQ price data under its own provenance manifest.
directional_regimes_not_defined.circularity_warning: defining bull/bear from trade outcomes on this tape would make 'policies do better in bull regimes' a tautology, because the same outcomes are the thing being measured

aggregate_execution_and_slippage.why_it_is_not_neutral_here: the parent filled one MNQ per accepted signal at R=1; copy-to-all fills N MNQ simultaneously, so the error in a perfect-fill assumption grows with N, which is the study axis itself

prop_firm_failure.reason: not modeled in the parent study; excluded here for comparability

rule_change.reason: not modeled in the parent study; excluded here for comparability

stress_scenarios.resolution: path order is locked as three arms; execution/slippage, prop-firm failure and rule change are declared non-models matching the parent

parent_comparison.purpose: the parent staggering arm is a descriptive composite benchmark, not a single-variable causal counterfactual
parent_comparison.comparison_interpretation: the delta combines a different PA opportunity set, removal of routing, and exposure multiplication: the parent routes one R=1 copy over 12,658 concurrent raw offers, while this study copies each of 9,299 globally selected opportunities to every eligible PA

not_adopted.target_pa_count_k: K=5 is a parent selection; N is this study's swept axis 1..20
not_adopted.time_based_external_capital_scope: the parent time-based through-first-activation bridge is narrowed locally to the explicit eval-1 renewal/activation chain
not_adopted.payout_policy_ranking: the six policies remain candidates, not optima
not_adopted.horizon_and_regimes: 720-day complete monthly cohorts and reporting-only regimes are selected locally; no parent result is inherited

parent_comparison.comparison_arm_rationale: the parent pinned pa_intratrade_path=mae_first. The seeded coin stays this study's internal delta_reference for its own path-order stress, but it is NOT the arm to difference against the parent.

renewal_at_the_hard_cap.rationale: a renewal fee buys capacity; do not buy capacity the book cannot hold
renewal_at_the_hard_cap.reachability: provably unreachable under the hard cap: a pass converts a running slot to an active slot one-for-one, so active == N implies running == 0 and the condition never binds. Kept as a written invariant, asserted by test, rather than as an operative branch.

mid_cycle_failure.parent_parity: reference/shared_source/evaluation.py breaks the trade loop on failed_dd, clears state, and advances one full cycle
mid_cycle_failure.dormant_slot_evidence: the parent's integrated simulator never assigns a failure status: EvaluationRuntime.status leaves 'active' only for 'passed' or 'closed_unpaid_renewal', and running_evaluation_count() counts status == 'active'. A failed, dormant Evaluation therefore keeps consuming a running-evaluation slot, and keeps paying renewal fees, until it passes or a renewal goes unfunded.
mid_cycle_failure.known_cost: a dormant Evaluation blocks a replacement slot and drains a $35 fee every 30 days. At high N, where copy-to-all makes deaths correlated, several slots can be blocked at once. This is faithful to the parent and is a modeled cost, not an artifact; report blocked-slot days per N.

trading_day_boundary.basis_source: parent legacy_25k_baseline.json time block; the user set the cutoff, the entry/exit basis is parent parity

resolved_user_decisions_2026_09_02.question: Does through-first-PA mean a time-based bridge for every permitted obligation before the first activation, or only the first PA chain?
resolved_user_decisions_2026_09_02.reason: it matches the intended statement that PAs 2..N are earned from treasury proceeds and prevents high N from receiving many externally funded Evaluations before PA 1 exists

resolved_user_decisions_2026_09_02.question: Which cash metric ranks policies?
resolved_user_decisions_2026_09_02.reason: it answers whether the book pays after every Evaluation, renewal, and activation fee; cumulative payout harvest remains a useful secondary metric

resolved_user_decisions_2026_09_02.question: Which deterministic alternate same-timestamp order should be the sensitivity arm?
resolved_user_decisions_2026_09_02.reason: it directly stresses the known cash-availability edge without randomizing event order

resolved_user_decisions_2026_09_02.question: How should an opportunity entered before but exiting after the cohort horizon be handled when no mark-to-market exists?
resolved_user_decisions_2026_09_02.reason: this preserves causal entry eligibility and the exact 720-day cutoff without inventing mark-to-market; it also matches the parent's event-loop treatment, and the open batch plus affected accounts must be reported

remaining_blockers_before_the_sweep: no parameter-sweep driver exists: the runner executes one (N, payout policy) arm per call, and the 20 x 6 grid across three path arms is not orchestrated, aggregated, or ranked
the required one-tick-per-side full-N execution sensitivity is not implemented; Lifecycle still hard-requires perfect_linear_no_slippage_fixture_only and cannot express the arm
the spend_before_payout ordering-sensitivity arm is constructible but has not been executed or reported
only N=1 has been run on the real tape; no N>1 book has ever been simulated, so copy-to-all correlated deaths are untested at scale

commercial_terms.why_explicit: the runtime bundle must not fall back to a dataclass default for a priced term; every fee that moves cash is named here with its rule source

executed_slices.purpose: first contact between the resolved contracts and the real tape; it proves the gate, the cycle-local Evaluation consumer and the lifecycle compose, and it is not evidence about any policy or N
